method: Browser read-only inspection of owner-operated tests; C++ host controller tests; standalone PlatformIO ESP-IDF build; independent source review; private previous-application readback; esptool write_flash and verify_flash bootloader+partitions+application; UART READY and explicit Stop acknowledgement.
environment: Windows local, COM7 CH343 ESP32-S3 N16R8 68ee8f4b6048, ESP-IDF6.1 / espressif32@7.1.3. Owner confirmed servos disconnected and V+ OFF during last test and was instructed to retain that state for programming.
limitations: No formal waveform/current/mechanical acceptance. S45 remains inconclusive; intermittent I2C fault remains unresolved.
Owner measurements and solder/polarity reports are not independent electrical or solder-joint inspections.
New error path is compiled and source reviewed; reproducing the physical failure with this image is the next test.
Agent sent only Stop, never arm/pulse. Without OE, failed I2C or frozen execution may leave old PWM active.
Four deferred error records preserve operation order. Reporting follows a shutdown attempt but can delay a subsequent retry; pin levels are instantaneous logic samples, not waveform capture.
